share.groups.label: Shared Session Groups
share.groups.help: Required source publication boundary: publish only sessions in these exact groups. The optional person filter narrows them further. Missing or empty groups publish nothing.

share.involvingProfileId.label: Involving Person
share.involvingProfileId.help: Optional exact source-local profile ID (including merge aliases). Narrows the required shared groups to canonical owners or profile participants. Mentions alone, names, and logins do not match.

nodes.label: Paired Node Attribution
nodes.help: Optional display attribution keyed by paired node id. Attribution never grants session access.

nodes.*.owner.label: Default Owner
nodes.*.owner.help: Local display owner for unattributed sessions: github:<login> or profile:<profileId>.

nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.label: Link GitHub Identities
nodes.*.linkGitHubIdentities.help: Trust this paired node's numeric GitHub account claims for local profile display attribution. Off by default.

recommendedPrompts: Help me plan Session Share between a source Gateway and a team Gateway. Ask which exact session groups and people should be included, explain the receiver audience and two-command read-only node connection, and show the setup steps. Do not publish sessions, pair a device, or broaden its command allowlist without approval.

Help me review a Session Share configuration for unintended exposure. Ask which source and receiver I mean, inspect only their authorized sharing metadata, and explain how the exact group filter and optional source-local person filter combine. Flag unmasked transcript content and receiver access limits without opening or sharing transcripts or changing settings.
